dispute.claim_text: I have a 20-day timeline of this. Day 1 I called, nobody replied. Day 3 I wrote again. The driver took a route that made no sense at 5 in the morning with zero traffic. I missed my flight and paid SGD 210 to rebook. I want the fare AND the rebooking fee. A 30-dollar voucher is an insult.

counterparty_statement.text: There was heavy fog on the SLE that morning so I went around. I got her to the airport. Missing check-in is between her and the airline; I'm a driver, not an insurer.
